reason: Concrete original KSVZ benchmark is fully specified independently of the later arbitrary representation family.
inspected_scope: Unbroken SM+KSVZ gauge-basis model Section2.7.1 Eqs.(76)-(79), PDFp21, family caveat pp21-22.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Benchmark KSVZ adds one vector-like colour-fundamental weak singlet Q with Y=0 and one complex gauge-singlet Phi. Generalization to a reducible sum(CQ,IQ,YQ) is an explicit representation family, not a unique numerical spectrum.

DFSZ adds two complex Higgs doublets Hu=(1,2,-1/2),Hd=(1,2,+1/2) replacing the single SM doublet, and complex singlet Phi. DFSZ-I/II lepton-Yukawa choices share this field content. Preserve source opposite-hypercharge orientation; current scalar-realification equivalence is not implemented.

claims.locator: Section2.7.1 first paragraph and Eqs.(76)-(79), PDFp21; last paragraph PDFp22
claims.fact: Extend SM by one vector-like colour fundamental weak-singlet Y=0 Dirac Q and one full SM-singlet complex Phi. Expand Q to LH3+LHbar3, Phi to two real singlet copies. Radial and axion coordinates are not added on top of Phi. PQ is global and not an extra gauge u1.

limitations: Only concrete original Q=(3,1,0) benchmark; later arbitrary reducible representation sum not converted to a false fixed spectrum.

source_pdfs.inspection: Fresh complete-page visual inspection and relevant source-definition reading.
